definitions.explanation: An enclosed space within a building, separated by walls and a door.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}の{部屋|へや}は2{階|かい}にあります。
examples.english: My room is on the second floor.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}を{掃除|そうじ}してください。
ホテルの{部屋|へや}を{予約|よやく}しました。

notes: A basic noun for any kind of room. Related compounds: {和室|わしつ} (Japanese-style room), {洋室|ようしつ} (Western-style room), {寝室|しんしつ} (bedroom), {居間|いま} (living room).
